description: One French medicine by its CIS code or exact official name, from the BDPM (France's official public medicines database, published by ANSM/CNAM). Returns the specialty's status and marketing authorization, every CIP13 pack presentation with its reimbursement rate and price, active-substance composition, HAS SMR/ASMR opinions (service medical rendu / amelioration du service medical rendu), generic-group membership and any "usage professionnel" restriction. Use for "what is the reimbursement rate for Doliprane 1000mg", "what is in CIS 60234100", or looking up a French drug by its exact brand/INN name. For partial or fuzzy name matches use fr_medicine_search first.

cis.description: CIS code (Code Identifiant de Specialite), e.g. "60234100".

name.description: Exact official denomination, e.g. "DOLIPRANE 1000 mg, comprimé". Case/accent-insensitive. Use fr_medicine_search for partial names.
